## What it is

Number 1, rendered blue. Back-left, 135°. Recessed 1. The bar carries the lowest opening, where the straight entry becomes the helix. Four openings: 20.5, 46.5, 72.5 and 98.5 mm above the deck. The helix starts in the lowest one. A curved slot at each end takes the ring and the disc.

## Design notes

- The bar sits on the tube. Each C is cut into the outer face. There is no neck.
- Print it on its side. The flat face is z = 0. The C is the layer outline.
- The mouth opens away from the centre. Press the tube in from outside. The inner face of the bar is solid.
- Bore 13.4 mm, wall 1.6 mm, mouth 11.5 mm. The bar is 8 mm thick. The bore climbs at 5.4°.
- The bottom slot is the base ring's arc, open through the outer face. The top slot is the disc, arcs at 42.2 and 44.8 mm, 1.4 mm deep. The recessed 1 is the only mark.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up. That puts the layer lines across the snap.
- Don't leave anything proud of the outer face. The tube has to press straight into the mouth.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: openings cut into the bar. The neck is gone. The foot still fits the old slot.
